title: Grok Bot Launches Own Email to Automate Service Signups

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Users can now assign unique email addresses to the Grok Bot AI to facilitate interactions with third party companies. The tool allows the AI to independently register for accounts, message businesses on a user's behalf, and organize calendar appointments. Those using the service can currently claim their specific bot email via a provided registration link.

The feature expansion was announced on Oct. 9 by the @bot account and promoted by Elon Musk. This update enables the AI assistant to act as a point of contact for external services rather than functioning solely as a chatbot interface.
